result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The full suite passes offline (607 tests, 0 failures).

The change is one SQL query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (around line 10020). It now uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority ...` clause as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`. I also updated its Javadoc to describe the new order. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and tickets from other regions are still excluded.

I did not add a test for the new ordering, and I did not commit.
